actors.title: 年輕朔・受傷撤離
actors.prompt: Use case: background-extraction and identity-preserve. Asset: transparent PNG reusable character sprite for a layered dark fantasy visual novel. Extract ONLY the young adult male swordsman in the foreground of image 1, preserving his exact face, black tied-up hair with stray strands, light facial hair, ivory and aged-gold patterned young swordsman robes, dark bronze bracers, broken dark red shoulder cord, and injured sword-gripping hand. Repose him slightly into a natural standing exhausted but fully conscious defensive/resting stance, calm wary expression. He has merely survived and retreated from his master, NOT defeated anyone: no victory pose, no raised trophy. Sword lowered in his right hand, hand with a small non-graphic injury stain, no fresh dripping blood. Thigh-up framing, complete head/hair, shoulders, arms/hands, and lowered sword guard visible with generous transparent margin. A 2:3 portrait composition, one isolated character only. Genuine transparent alpha background, NOT checkerboard, NOT solid background. No environment, shadows on a floor, buildings, background silhouettes, master, friend, smoke, weapons floating separately, text, UI, card frame or watermark. Keep semi-realistic painterly fantasy style and realistic anatomy and identity. Slight cool ambient and warm neutral edge lighting suitable for compositing on both tower and road.
actors.visualQA: Viewed reference and output: same young male face, black topknot, ivory/antique gold robes, broken red shoulder cord, injured right sword hand, lowered sword and exhausted alert posture; no master or victory pose. True generated alpha preserved without postprocessing.
